headline: Approved: 20 residential units in mill building at 12 Pearl Street, and a 7,500-square-foot building at Three Digital Drive.
summary: The 12 Pearl Street project was approved with conditions, including a parking agreement with the Pearl Street garage and a structural check of an existing stone wall. The Three Digital Drive site plan was approved again after its earlier approval lapsed. Other business included a discussion of the mayor's annual committee report and future ordinance work.
decisions: Approved the final subdivision and site plan for 12 Pearl Street, with waivers for parking and stormwater, unanimously.
Approved the final site plan for a 7,500 square foot commercial building at Three Digital Drive, unanimously, with a contour waiver.
discussion: Pearl Street parking: Members asked whether the garage has room for the 20 needed spaces. The applicant said Premium Parking confirmed capacity, but snow emergencies fill the garage.
Retaining wall at 12 Pearl Street: Members said the stone wall between 12 and 10 Pearl Street needs a structural engineer's review before an occupancy permit is issued.
Tenant safety at Three Digital Drive: Members asked how fire and storage risks would be checked. Staff said fire and code enforcement review each tenant before occupancy.
Annual committee report: Members discussed ordinance changes, starting the next comprehensive plan early, and working with other committees and Saco.

decision_evidence.quote: All right, we have a motion by Rob to approve. I'll second. Second by Chico. ... All those in favor? That's unanimous.
I'll make a motion to approve case number 2026.48. ... All those in favor? That's unanimous.
